parsed.rationale: All four records are unnamed extensions on `URLSession` spread across four distinct packages — `Playlist` (PlaylistFetcher.swift:31), `Core` (URLSession+WebSession.swift:13), `Playback` (URLSessionProtocol.swift:24), and `MusicShareKit` (RequestService.swift:42). The structural evidence carries null Jaccard similarity, null shared-field-count, and null shared-ancestor, meaning the pipeline has no content-level evidence that these extensions overlap; the only signal is that they all extend the same Foundation type. Each extension almost certainly adds package-specific conformances or helpers (e.g., a `WebSession` protocol conformance in Core, a streaming-oriented protocol conformance in Playback) that are intentionally scoped to their respective packages. Consolidating them into a single package would create an inappropriate cross-domain dependency and would not reduce real duplication.
